text: The question-first raw-observation vignette executes end to end and pkgdown renders the article, contract, and grouped API reference. Full source suite is green. Fresh public-map (576 nodes, full covariance sweep 86.8 s, 2.22e-16 oracle, 145 MB RSS) and query-first (1,080 nodes, 100 conditions, 3.54 s fused vs 13.53 s materialized, 4.44e-16 oracle, 338 MB RSS) gates pass; both 50k topology gates pass. A light source build and R CMD check --as-cran complete with 0 errors, 0 warnings, and 2 expected publication/tooling notes when run under a valid C locale.
